description.value: More Bikes West Van is the West Vancouver outpost of a multi-location Vancouver-area bike shop carrying major brands including Giant, Liv, Kona, Rocky Mountain, and Brodie. The shop offers a full complement of bikes, parts, apparel, and accessories alongside a dedicated repair and maintenance service. Touring cyclists will find the store particularly useful for its broad accessories catalog spanning bags, luggage, and drivetrain components.

address.value: 1437 Clyde Ave, West Vancouver, BC V7T 1E9, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at morebikes.ca is active and confirms More Bikes operates multiple locations including West Van, selling major brands (Giant, Liv, Kona, Rocky Mountain) and offering a dedicated bike repair service page ('Vancouver Bike Repair Services | Tune-Up, Repairs & Maintenance'). The website product catalog explicitly lists panniers, pannier racks, frame bags, and handlebar bags, confirming touring-relevant parts stock. The contact page content was truncated before location-specific details (address, phone) for the West Van store could be extracted, so those fields remain unconfirmed.
concerns: No address or phone number available in OSM record or extractable from website content (contact page was truncated before location-specific details appeared); the West Van location's physical address could not be confirmed.
OSM record has no amenity tags and no osm_id, suggesting it may not yet be mapped in OpenStreetMap as a distinct node.
Website banner announces Kitsilano location has moved to 1828 W. 4th Ave. — worth verifying West Van location remains open and has not also relocated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active multi-location bike shop with repair services and a broad parts catalog — clearly useful to touring cyclists in the West Vancouver area.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Website catalog explicitly lists panniers, pannier racks, frame bags, handlebar bags, saddle bags, and travel bags as stocked product categories
